intelligence.human_view: Think of NayaNET as a kingdom of rooms, and every room is staged the same way — the same elegant frame around everything in it, the same flowing stage that carries you from room to room without ever leaving. The frame is not decoration; it is how the system says "this matters." When a page looks wrong, you don't build a new room — you take the room that already looks right, the agreement's own frame, and you change only what's inside it: the words, the picture, the button. A page his eye rejects goes in the bin whole, not patched up. Under the floorboards, every pipe and wire gets judged: keep it, drop it, or fix it — and the Smart Vault is the middle of the whole map, where all the intelligence lives and every citizen has their own. The work runs in order: Personal first, then the Hub and the main page live, then proof that it all works together as one. And before you ask him for a permission, check the keys you already hold — the answer may have been given weeks ago.
intelligence.simple_view: Every page sits in a pretty frame, like a picture in a frame! The frame moves back and forth, like a swing, and you never leave the room! If a page looks wrong, we throw it out and put new words inside the good frame! Your own Vault is the middle of the map, and every part must help it! First we fix Personal, then we go live, then we show it all works together! And Shawn's eyes are the boss — if it looks wrong to him, we start again!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — every page sits in the same lovely frame, dear, like every room in a beautiful house dressed the same way, and the frame flows back and forth so you never leave the room, love! If a page looks wrong to his eye, dear, we throw it right out — we never patch it up — and we take the good frame we already have and just change the words inside it! Underneath it all, love, the Smart Vault is the middle of the map, where all the cleverness lives, and every little piece must help it or it goes! And we do it in order, dear: Personal first, then the Hub goes live, then we prove it all works together as one! And before we ask him for a key, love, we check the keys we already hold — the answer may have been given weeks ago!
